question: Which of the following elements is found in the p-block?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nitrogen**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Nitrogen (N)** is an element belonging to Group 15 of the periodic table, which is part of the p-block.
 
• The p-block elements are characterized by having their valence electrons in the p orbital.
 
• Nitrogen is a non-metal and forms a variety of compounds, including ammonia (NH₃) and nitric acid (HNO₃).
 
• It is essential for life as it is a key component of amino acids, proteins, and nucleic acids.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The p-block** is located on the right side of the periodic table and includes Groups 13-18.
 
• Elements in the p-block exhibit a wide range of properties, including metals, nonmetals, and metalloids.
 
• The p-block consists of important elements like carbon, oxygen, nitrogen, fluorine, and noble gases.
 
• The periodic table is divided into blocks (s, p, d, and f) based on the type of atomic orbital that receives electrons last.
 
• **Nitrogen cycle:** Nitrogen is a critical element in the environment, cycling through the atmosphere, soil, and living organisms in a process known as the nitrogen cycle.
